long_biography.plain_text:
The purchase of Gulf and Western's sugar and tourism operations changed the scale of Alfonso Fanjul Jr.'s family business. Working with his brother José, he led the acquisition that added Florida and Dominican assets. Further purchases brought New York refining capacity and brands including Domino into the group.

Fanjul now serves with José as co-chairman and co-chief executive of Fanjul Corp. The wider enterprise connects cane farming and milling with refining, marketing, renewable energy and property. Its leadership also distinguishes their generation from the next: José Fanjul Jr. and Luis Fernandez are co-presidents, while Alfonso's younger brothers retain divisional and board responsibilities.
